nodes.description: Private owner address stored in Accessibility; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner.
InvestorsStorage instance holding all investor investments and payment times; recreated on each new wave.
RapidGrowthProtection struct tracking daily investment limits and activity window.
PrivateEntrance struct gating whitelisted investor max investment until endTimestamp.
Mapping marking addresses that already consumed the one-time referral bonus.
Address receiving advertising commission sent during doInvest; settable only by owner.
Address receiving admin commission sent during doInvest; settable only by owner.
Counter of investments, incremented in doInvest and reset in nextWave.
Timestamp of the current wave startup, set in nextWave.
Percent struct defining the advertising commission rate applied to received ether.
Payable fallback: routes zero-value calls to getMyDividends and value calls to doInvest with referrer decoded from msg.data.
Main deposit routine: applies growth/private limits, pays commissions, handles referrals, reinvests dividends and registers investor.
Withdraws accrued dividends for msg.sender, updates payment time and transfers ETH; can trigger nextWave.
Computes accrued dividends from investment, elapsed time and current daily percent.
Selects the daily percent tier based on the contract ETH balance.
Private routine replacing m_investors with a fresh InvestorsStorage, resetting counters and restarting growth protection.
Reads investor info from storage into an in-memory Investor struct.
Owner-only initializer configuring rapid growth protection and private entrance parameters.
Owner-only setter validating non-zero address before updating advertisingAddress.
Owner-only setter validating non-zero address before updating adminsAddress.
Constructor setting admin/advertising addresses and calling nextWave to bootstrap the first wave.
Accessibility constructor assigning owner from msg.sender.
Modifier enforcing msg.sender == owner on privileged functions.
Caller address; used for ownership checks, investor identity and ETH transfers.
Current block time (now); used for payment timing, dividend accrual and wave start.
msg.sender.transfer(dividends) inside getMyDividends; external ETH transfer made after state updates.
advertisingAddress.send(percent amount) inside doInvest; raw send whose failure is ignored.
adminsAddress.send(percent amount) inside doInvest; raw send whose failure is ignored.
msg.sender.transfer(excess) refunding overpayment inside doInvest.
Inline assembly mload in Address.toAddress decoding an address from attacker-controlled msg.data.
Referrer address argument of doInvest.
Working investment amount local variable in doInvest.
Computed dividends local variable in getMyDividends.
Investor address argument of calcDividends.
Contract ETH balance local variable in dailyPercent.
Overpayment excess amount local variable in doInvest.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against the stored owner state variable to gate privileged functions.
onlyOwner reads msg.sender as the caller identity for the access check.
Accessibility constructor initializes owner from msg.sender, establishing privileged control.
getMyDividends uses msg.sender both to look up investor state and as the ETH transfer recipient.
msg.sender is the recipient of transfer(dividends), enabling callback into the contract.
doInvest uses msg.sender for investor registration, referral checks and refunds.
getMyDividends enforces a 24 hour interval and stores payment time using block.timestamp.
calcDividends derives accrued dividends from block.timestamp minus payment time, a timestamp dependency.
doInvest records payment time and emits time-dependent values using now.
nextWave records waveStartup and restarts growth protection using now.
Computed dividends flow into an external ETH transfer to the caller before the function returns.
getMyDividends obtains the dividend amount from calcDividends.
getMyDividends triggers nextWave when the contract balance cannot cover the dividends.
Commission computed from received ether is forwarded to advertisingAddress via send.
Commission computed from received ether is forwarded to adminsAddress via send.
Excess ether is refunded to the caller with transfer, an external call during deposit processing.
doInvest reads accrued dividends from calcDividends for automatic reinvestment.
doInvest increments the investmentsNumber state counter.
doInvest writes m_referrals to mark that the caller consumed the referral bonus.
doInvest queries and updates investor records inside m_investors.
doInvest reads and writes the rapid growth protection struct when it is active.
doInvest consults private entrance limits when growth protection is inactive.
calcDividends loads the investor record through getMemInvestor.
calcDividends scales the investment by the current daily percent tier.
getMemInvestor reads investment and payment time from the m_investors storage contract.
nextWave deploys and assigns a fresh InvestorsStorage to m_investors.
nextWave writes the waveStartup timestamp state variable.
nextWave restarts the rapid growth protection window via startAt.
init configures maximum daily investment and activity days in m_rgp.
init configures the private entrance storages, max investment and end timestamp.
Finplether constructor assigns the initial advertisingAddress from msg.sender.
Finplether constructor assigns the initial adminsAddress from msg.sender.
Finplether constructor invokes nextWave to bootstrap the initial wave.
setAdvertisingAddress writes the advertisingAddress state variable.
setAdminsAddress writes the adminsAddress state variable.
Fallback dispatches zero-value calls to getMyDividends.
Fallback dispatches value-bearing calls to doInvest.
Fallback decodes the referrer address from msg.data using inline assembly toAddress.
The address decoded from msg.data is passed as referrerAddr into doInvest.
External transfer to msg.sender can re-enter getMyDividends during withdrawal.
send to advertisingAddress can execute fallback code of that address during doInvest.
send to adminsAddress can execute fallback code of that address during doInvest.
Refund transfer to msg.sender re-enters doInvest before deposits complete.
dailyPercent selects the tier from percent state variables such as m_advertisingPercent.
referrerAddr parameter feeds the referral logic of doInvest.
investment local variable carries the deposit amount through doInvest.
dividends local variable holds the payout amount in getMyDividends.
investorAddr parameter drives the dividend lookup in calcDividends.
balance local variable selects the percent tier in dailyPercent.
excess local variable sets the refund amount for transfer in doInvest.

normalization_plan.reason: The referrerAddr parameter exists only to feed the referral logic of doInvest and has no independent semantic identity.
The investment local variable is a temporary accumulator entirely contained within doInvest.
The dividends local variable is a temporary payout value computed and consumed inside getMyDividends.
The investorAddr parameter is used solely by calcDividends to read the investor record.
The balance local variable is a transient value used only to pick the percent tier in dailyPercent.
The excess local variable directly determines the refund amount passed to the external transfer.
